title: Clasio x Rosenfeld - What Am I Doing Wrong (Lyric Video) | SuicideSheep
description: A lyric video for Clasio and Rosenfeld's What Am I Doing Wrong, released through MrSuicideSheep.
overview: What Am I Doing Wrong pairs the track's lyrics with a sparse, evolving visual system centred on a single rose.
The restrained palette and repeated floral motif leave space for the words, creating a quiet, memorable visual companion to the song.
